title: The 8 Levels of Relationship Status
house: A bustling metropolitan fruit and vegetable city named Verdantia, featuring neon-lit transit hubs, crowded apartment complexes, expensive downtown lofts, and cozy corner coffee shops where produce people navigate modern love.
links: Level 2's barista mentions a quiet blueberry man who always leaves a huge tip, foreshadowing Level 7.
Level 4's apartment hallway echoes the loud arguments from Level 1's neighboring flat.
Level 6's upscale rooftop bar overlooks the exact bench where Level 3 sat alone in the rain.
Level 5's subway station features the same ticket kiosk where Level 2 dropped her coffee.

levels.name: Maya, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 1. 0 Days Single und gerade vor allen Kunden im Café abserviert worden? Ich bin Maya (Erdbeere) und mein glühendes Stirn-Badge brüllt '0 Days Single' für jeden sichtbar – während mein Ex eiskalt sagt: Du findest nie wieder jemanden, der dich liebt! Aber er ahnt nicht, dass mein geheimer Kassenbon genau das Gegenteil beweist... Level 1: 0 days single – and already scrolling through my phone in absolute panic while standing behind the counter of Bean & Leaf Cafe. My glowing forehead badge reads 0 Days Single, flashing like a neon warning sign to the entire city of Verdantia. You're way too clingy for my taste, we are officially done. I stood there frozen, humiliated in front of every single commuter waiting for their morning caffeine fix, desperately clutching a cold oat milk latte. You will never find anyone who actually loves you. Das siehst du in Level 2. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Oliver, 26, Delivery Rider
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 2. 14 Tage Single und im übelsten Gewitter unterwegs, um Miete zu zahlen? Ich bin Oliver (Orange), und mein Badge blinkt '14 Days Single' – bis dieser arrogante Wachmann Marcus meine Lieferung einfach in den Müll wirft und spottet: Niemand will hier einen gebrochenen Mann! Doch er weiß nicht, dass im Paket der Schlüssel zu seinem eigenen Jobverlust liegt... Level 2: 14 days single – and pedaling through a freezing thunderstorm to pay rent in a gloomy residential block. I'm Oliver, a crisp orange citrus person with bright textured peel, standing in a dim apartment hallway holding a soggy cardboard box. My glowing forehead badge reads 14 Days Single, a constant reminder of the text message that ended our three-year lease. You really thought a delivery guy could keep a woman like me happy for long? I gripped the handlebars of my heavy delivery bicycle, the rain soaking straight through my cotton jacket as bitter cold wind whipped around the concrete corners. Drop your packages outside, nobody wants a broken man in this building. Das siehst du in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Chloe, 28, Accountant
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 3. 6 Monate Single und nachts um 2 Uhr im leeren Büro eingesperrt? Ich bin Chloe (Pflaume), mein Badge leuchtet '6 Months Single', als die eiskalte Chefin Victoria vorbeistolziert und mir droht: Hör auf mit dem Liebeskummer, sonst fliegst du fristlos! Sie hat keine Ahnung, dass ich gerade alle ihre Finanz-Geheimnisse aufgedeckt habe... Level 3: 6 months single – and staring at a tax spreadsheet at 2 AM in an empty corporate office tower. I'm Chloe, a sleek purple plum person with smooth dark skin, sitting at a glass desk on the 40th floor under harsh flickering lights. My glowing forehead badge reads 6 Months Single, glowing a cool blue beneath fluorescent strip lighting. You spent three years building spreadsheets instead of building a family with me. I swallowed hard, refusing to let him see a single tear roll down my smooth purple cheek while I compiled confidential ledger entries. Stop wasting time on your failed love life or your career is finished here. Das siehst du in Level 4. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Leo, 29, Architect
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 4. 1 Jahr Single und am Verzweifeln im Rohbau? Ich bin Leo (Banane), mein Badge zeigt '1 Year Single', und ich schufte wie ein Verrückter, als plötzlich mein Ex auftaucht und mir an den Kopf wirft: Du hast unsere Zukunft für nichts weggegeben! Aber warte nur ab, bis die Baugenossenschaft erfährt, wer hier wirklich betrogen hat... Level 4: 1 year single – and sketching blueprints for a luxury penthouse I can barely afford inside an industrial construction site. I'm Leo, a smooth yellow banana person with a clean-cut look, standing in an unfinished loft surrounded by thick concrete dust and buzzing power tools. My glowing forehead badge reads 1 Year Single, a sharp contrast to the 3-year anniversary ring I threw away in disgust. You traded our three years together for a fancy career that means nothing to anyone. I gripped my architectural pen so tightly my fingers turned pale yellow while drafting structural supports. Finish this blueprint by morning or your contract is canceled permanently. Das siehst du in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Marcus, 31, Security Guard
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 5. 1 Jahr verlobt und von der eigenen Verlobten ignoriert? Ich bin Marcus (Brokkoli), Security-Guard im Luxus-Tower, Badge '1 Year Engaged', während die arrogante Victoria mich anpöbelt: Du bildest dir wohl einiges auf deinen Ring ein! Sie lacht jetzt noch – bis sie merkt, dass ich den Master-Schlüssel zu ihrem Penthouse habe... Level 5: 1 year engaged – and standing guard at the lobby entrance while my fiancée repeatedly ghosts my emergency calls. I'm Marcus, a stern broccoli person with dense green florets, holding a heavy clipboard in a luxury high-rise lobby filled with marble pillars. My glowing forehead badge reads 1 Year Engaged, glowing in proud green neon lights for every resident. You think flashing a ring makes you better than everyone else working in this building. I tightened my grip on my security radio, my green florets twitching with suppressed irritation as I monitored the security monitors. Drop your attitude or your uniform goes in the trash by tonight. Das siehst du in Level 6. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Julian, 33, Investor
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 6. 3 Jahre verheiratet und stockbesoffen auf der VIP-Rooftop-Party? Ich bin Julian (Avocado), Badge '3 Years Married', und ich lache über alle Singles, bis mir die Buchhalterin ins Gesicht spuckt: Deine Ehe ist nur eine Fassade wegen des Geldes! Mein Lächeln friert ein, denn sie hat recht – und mein Konto ist leer... Level 6: 3 years married – and sipping expensive champagne while openly judging everyone else's dating failures at a high-end club. I'm Julian, a smooth green avocado person with a tailored Italian suit, lounging in a leather booth at an exclusive rooftop lounge. My glowing forehead badge reads 3 Years Married, shining in bright gold numbers above my pit. You act like your marriage is bulletproof, but everyone knows your spouse is only staying for your bank account. I smirked and adjusted my silk tie, refusing to let her petty jealousy ruin my evening of total luxury. Enjoy the view while it lasts, sir, because perfection never lasts forever in this city. Das siehst du in Level 7. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Victoria, 35, CEO
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 7. 5 Jahre verheiratet und knallhart am Verhandeln, während mein Mann mich betrügt? Ich bin Victoria (Drachenfrucht), Badge '5 Years Married', und ich lasse mir nichts anmerken, als mir an den Kopf geworfen wird: Deine Ehe bricht gerade in Trümmern zusammen! Doch wer zuletzt lacht, kontrolliert die gesamten Firmenanteile... Level 7: 5 years married – and finalizing a multi-million dollar corporate merger while my husband vacations alone in secret. I'm Victoria, an elegant dragonfruit person with bright pink skin and green scales, sitting at the head of a massive mahogany board table. My glowing forehead badge reads 5 Years Married, gleaming in platinum light under chandelier illumination. I kept my composure, my pink dragonfruit scales tightening with controlled fury as I reviewed the portfolio. levels.name: Arthur, 72, Patriarch
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship status after three years. Level 8. 10 Jahre verheiratet und am Ende des Lebens? Ich bin Arthur (Wassermelone), Badge '10 Years Married', und ich blicke auf all die falschen Zahlen zurück, während draußen Maya steht und mich anfleht: Hör auf, dich hinter diesem Stirn-Badge zu verstecken! Das ist die letzte Abrechnung in Verdantia... Level 8: 10 years married – and looking back at a lifetime of numbers that never truly defined anything important in life. I'm Arthur, an ancient watermelon person with dark green striped skin and wise grey seed freckles, standing on the grand marble balcony of the city estate. My glowing forehead badge reads 10 Years Married, glowing in a soft, warm golden light that outshines every neon sign in Verdantia. You act like your number gives you all the answers, but you've been hiding behind that display for a decade. I smiled softly, leaning against my carved wooden walking cane as the city lights flickered across the skyline. The number on your forehead only shows what others expect to see, but love is the only equation that never expires. What theme of our city should we explore next?
